Man, I know the person-stuck-in-timeloop thing has been done many, many times, but Timeworn's writing is still really touching.
Sometimes even stuff used many times is great
Why else would it be used so many times?

I mean, some tropes get used a lot of times because it's the path-more-travelled. It's easy to just do what's been done before. That said, they pulled off Timeworn well. Probably because by this point we've gotten invested in Ramona.
The stuff love does to a person

We get to be in the "what could have been" timeline, so we get to see both sides of the timeloop character, which I think a lot of stories don't do. It's why RvB: The Shizno Paradox had a genuinely great ending, despite the rest of the season being a very mixed bag.
